P1_P2: Identical source/destination compute GPU and WAN occupancy implies identical PCC, electrical constraints, rho and H4 headroom/shortfall.
P3: Sum of route binaries equals exactly one per selected checkpoint migration; pre-start placement contributes zero.
P4: 2*g*duration minus twice source-reference overlap minus twice destination-reference overlap equals full original occupancy symmetric difference.
P5: Original sorted option rank is base(destination,restart)+rank(source,destination); exact integer identity checked for every enumerated option. Existing cohort index and objective priority remain unchanged.
checkpoint_authority: Existing first valid checkpoint selected by V39C binder; subsequent cadence points are audit metadata, not pruned alternatives from the current 4.25M explicit model.
forward: Each original migration option sets its route and destination-arrival binary; each stay sets its placement binary.
method: Exact source-route / destination-arrival marginal factorization for uniform transfer duration; all nonuniform jobs retain explicit options
no_new_or_lost_choices: Cartesian equality to the original finite domain is asserted and exhaustively checked on three deterministic reduced instances.
reverse: Binary one-choice and route/arrival destination conservation select exactly one legal source/destination/restart tuple. Every allowed route has the same complete arrival set at that destination, asserted by the compiler.
scientific_model_counts: Exact full compressed variables and constraints will be persisted in PRIMARY_STRUCTURE before the first solve; equivalence is a prerequisite enforced by the optimizer.
